report:
Problems capturing Oracle LOB CLOB fields during update event capture

I am having the following issue:
When I create my debezium connector in kafaka, I have the lob.enabled option set to true, which allows me to perform a read of the LOB CLOB fields of my table in Oracle 19C which works correctly for the snapshot and the inserts that are made new in the table, when updates are presented in the table data, the read that perform debezium of my LOB CLOB field is shown with the message: __debezium_unavailable_value, which does not make sense due to this lob.enabled=true option.
I would like to know if anyone in the community has had this type of error and what solution we can apply to solve this message for the update operations.
Best Regards.

evidence.quote: what you're seeing is normal behavior for LOB columns ... If you do not modify the LOB column in the UPDATE operation, Oracle simply does not record LOB column data in the redo logs

notes: __debezium_unavailable_value for unchanged LOBs on UPDATE is intended; use reselect post processor.
